What an absolutely horrible and devastating experience. I genuinely wish I had read the reviews before bringing my dog here. I never imagined a veterinary office could mishandle something this serious so badly.

I brought my pregnant dog to Balboa Veterinary Medical Center specifically because I needed professional guidance about when she was due and whether she might require a C-section. She is a small breed, and C-sections are commonly necessary, so this was not a minor concern.

During the appointment, I felt like the veterinarian barely examined her. I was essentially told that they could not tell me when she was due and that I should call when she went into labor so they could determine whether a C-section was necessary. During that same visit, I was specifically told that another veterinarian at the practice performed surgeries.

When my dog eventually went into labor, I took her to an emergency veterinarian and was told that she needed a C-section. I immediately called Balboa Veterinary Medical Center, expecting the help I had previously been led to believe they could provide. Instead, I was told, “We don’t do surgery here. You’ll need to find somewhere else.”

I was completely shocked. I had brought my dog there specifically to prepare for this exact situation, paid approximately $100 for the initial appointment, and was then left scrambling during a medical emergency to find another facility capable of performing the surgery.

The consequences were devastating. During the delay in obtaining the C-section my dog needed, all of her puppies died, and my dog nearly died as well. I cannot adequately describe how traumatic and heartbreaking this experience was.

In my experience, the lack of clear communication, preparation, and appropriate guidance was unacceptable. When someone brings a pregnant animal to a veterinarian specifically asking about the possibility of a C-section, they should leave knowing exactly what the facility can and cannot provide and what to do if an emergency occurs. I did not receive that level of care or clarity.

If you love your pet, I strongly recommend researching other veterinary options before coming here. I would never trust this facility with another one of my animals after what happened. The entire experience was devastating, and I believe my dog and her puppies deserved far better care.
Hi, Theajoy. Great to hear that you had a good experience at Balboa Veterinary Medical Center. We really appreciate you taking the time to share!

I had a poor experience at Balboa Veterinary Clinic. Aside from the long wait times and dismissive attitude of the staff, I was very unhappy with the way my dog was handled during our visit. The lack of care and professionalism was disheartening, and I will not be returning.

I brought my dog, Penny, for routine blood work. Immediately after, he developed a firm 4cm mass on his left hip where he was injected. I had the mass tested by a pathologist, and the report confirmed that the cytologic features are consistent with a vaccine or injection reaction. Despite providing this professional pathology report to them, they have refused to take responsibility or offer a refund for the costs incurred. I am deeply disappointed by their lack of accountability and professional care

I brought my dog in for blood work and when he came back to us we noticed he was wet on his left hip. He started developing a bump but thought it will go down on its own. It didn’t so got it tested where the results stated that it was an infection from a vaccine or injection. Yet they still refuse to take responsibility.
Very nice front office staff. They're very friendly and helpful.  The doctor,  unfortunately we don't have a face to face  because of covid, but my dog is treated very well and he seems nice.
Thank you so much for sharing your great experience with us, Michael !
Hidden fees. Called ahead of time, was told no vet exam needed. Day of appt, was told exam needed, extra $98.

Horrible experience schedule for spay 9am called at 12. I was told my dog was prepped to go next. Called at 1:30. I was told that my dog was going to be prepped to go next. Lied to me twice. Crated my dog 5 hours acte fasting from night before since 9pm. Lost trust picked up my dog no service. Don’t take ur pets there! They don’t care about animals!
All the girls were very friendly.

UPDATE- Sad I have to write this review. Been taking my dogs here for 10 years plus, had surgery, teeth cleaned, numerous shots and office visits. Today they charged me $195.00 for a librela shot for a 13 pound dog. After talking with friends and asking another nearby vet how much this should cost I was quoted $73.00. When asking Balboa about this they said you signed the contract. I did and it will be the last contract ever signed. You lost a long term customer over greed and I will continue services where they charge the normal amount.

My last review before this nonsense!

Balboa veterinary clinic has taken care of our two dogs since 2015. They always make things as easy as possible and really care for our dogs. We just had both dogs taken for two surgical procedures on the same day and everything turned out great. Both dogs are recovering together at home. Really reasonable with pricing also. Great place for animal care!
Thanks to the people who work in the veterinary they are very professional and the price is affordable I brought my 4-legged daughter for a dental cleaning

This was such an awful experience for me and my girl.   The first visit is free because they don’t do anything on the first visit.   Candace Johnson didn’t lay a hand on my girl.    I brought her there for nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea    She would have needed to at least examine her to find out what was wrong    instead she brought her in the back and gave her a B12 shot (allegedly).  I also brought in a stool sample to be sent out to see if she had parasites. Michelle told me it would be 24 to 48 hours to get the results when I called after 48 hours she told me it could be up to a week
I told her that that was unacceptable and went into their office the next day    they printed out a piece of paper in front of me that showed she did not have any parasites.  I don’t believe they ever sent out her sample and that this paper was bogus. In addition, the office is filthy.  The staff is not knowledgeable at all and not very friendly.    What a shame.
Great and knowledgeable veterinary clinic!

We had an appointment to establish care for our new dog set for 10:30AM. We arrived early since it was his first time in this new place. Our initial interaction with the front office was fine.  We were roomed but were left sitting and waiting for 45 minutes after our appointment time until someone finally came in to inform us that the doctor was finishing up a surgery. We were offered to reschedule the appointment but opted to wait another 10 minutes because the vet tech said the doctor might be out in that time. Unfortunately, the doctor still wasn’t available and we left our appointment after an hour of waiting. Communication early on would have been more appropriate and we wouldn’t have left feeling terrible about this interaction.

Thank you to the staff and dr for continuing to treat our grumpy old lady with genuine love and care for her ! We know shes a hand full and very opinionated!

Thank you for everything
- April Knight and family
Very nice people , never a long wait and what services I've had done are very reasonable: )
Awesome staff. I took two dogs and one of them is a handful. Old and grumpy. They were very helpful and professional.
I called to ask if they work on turtles but instead the receptionist put me on hold because she “needs” to put me on hold after i stated i had a quick question. 20+ minutes on hold for 2 seconds

Very disappointed. We called the clinic multiple times to confirm that Dr. Arzumanyan would see us. On the day of the visit, we were told again that everything was fine. Took the day off, came to the clinic — and the doctor wasn’t working that day!

No one informed us. This is not how a professional clinic should operate.
Hi, Araz. We appreciate the rating. So glad we could provide you with a positive experience at Balboa Veterinary Medical Center!

Full service for small dogs.
Dogs happy. I'm happy.

I been so picky with a vet because well so far all of them just seem blah. Even the front desk people just seem so blah. Idk like no personality or warmth to make you feel like your dogs in good hands, Not caring ,engaging, or personal. Its just like they just working.i been to about 12 places. My brother has been bringing our dogs here so I finally went to see how it goes... the only reason I'm giving this place the stars I am is due to Paola and Zamira. For a first time I felt like they actually cared and loved dogs. They were  clear on communication and listened to me. Especially Paola. There was one girl there that was bleh. I hope people that work at vets realize that we dog lovers get super stressed out, and don't get me started with the prices, I mean when did people stop working for the love of it. But anyways prices here are respectful compared to a place that wanted to charge me $1000 for each dog dental cleaning.  I have 3 dogs.! Anyways the place is small and quiet but those two girls made it a comfy expirance for me. They were alive and hopeful and just made you feel warm. I hope they stay that way and that they remember that we are people and some love and care goes a long way. I can't comment on the veterinarian because I was waiting for her/him as I'm typing this and I don't want to wait anymore to post it, or I will forget

Super clean , on time, very friendly staff and doctor on duty.
I’m super impressed.
Always a pleasure to go to. Great service, everyone is super nice and affordable.
Service was great and friendly. I would highly recommend!

I'm happy to have found  them.
They are taking really good care of Alli and soon Brody will be with them too

Additionally the staff is always so kind and caring towards me and my babies.  I would highly recommend folks using their services for your animals.

Really like the Dr. A and the staff. They are knowledgeable and accommodating. I trust them with my dog. The only reason I didn't give them five stars is because the office space itself is unkempt and in a state of disrepair. It obviously has not been attended to in decades. They need to remodel.

Dr. A and the team are amazing. I have been going here for over 10 years for my pets, and have only positive experiences. Recently I went in to get all the records ready for flying abroad, and they have helped with every request I had. Caring and supportive veterinary clinic.

Love this office . The staff is warm, friendly and always helpful. The vets are awesome. They always see my pets in a timely namer.. over all a great office. Thank you for taking such good care of my fur children 🙌🏼 …
They are all awesome people there
Thank you for taking the time to rate us, Lily! We are delighted that you had a great experience with Balboa Veterinary Medical Center .
Staff are extremely friendly and great level of care provided!

I have been taking my dog to Balboa vet for a few years now for her Arthritis treatments and annual exams. They have been amazingly helpful & kind everytime we go. My dog Nala gets excited when we go & she loves all the staff here. Thank you all for the good work you to care for our pets. I Highly recommend Balboa vet to anyone looking for a vet!

We had the best experience getting Bailey’s teeth cleaned. She was taken really good care of and I really appreciate their wonderful customer service. They are also affordable. We will continue our relationship with them. Recommended!

We have been going to BVM since the dog was born without any problems.
The staff is caring and gentle and answering all of our questions. Thank You Ladies.
Craig P

For 2 days she was given excellent care and we were notified of everything that was happening. She’s now home, being treated outpatient and doing fantastic, thanks to everyone at Balboa Veterinary Medical Center
Very good clinic . They provide discounts on specific days for a shots .

My pup Rexy was having a heavy dry cough after boarding for several days and I called them on Monday morning hoping for an early visit and they did not disappoint me.  I was able to get him there right away. The doctor and staff are super friendly and very helpfull and my dog feels comfortable when there.  Thanks very much Balboa Vet Ctr.
Balboa Vet is the best vet care we have ever had. They love our fur babies. As much as we do.

So why ask how much he weighs if you are lazy not to update it in tge system. If only my general doctor can do that when i was a baby 😬

Great customer service they took care of my puppy so well !

The doctor was very attentive to the concerns that I had about my cat. The office staff are pleasant and attentive as well.  Both my cats are patients at Balboa Veterinary Medical Center, and I am quite satisfied with the care my cats have received.
Good
